fields.title: Gaming PC - RTX 3080, Ryzen 7 3800X
fields.description:
Selling my gaming pc as I upgraded to a 5080.
GPU: RTX 3080 10GB
CPU: Ryzen 7 3800x
16gb Corsair rgb ram
2tb hard drive
Performance equivalent to RTX 5080 at 1080p, honestly.
Waiting for my 5080 so this has to go.
Swap for RTX 5080 considered.
RTX 4090 not included.
